notes.title: Listen! Let us hear the breathing song of an angel!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38884948/854946899c365c2bee6674599c6873eeaf2b8019.png[/img]

Reporting in, Commander!
Here are the patch notes for the latest server update:
[list]
[*] Sweet and beautiful melodies incoming! Her enchant will touch your soul, her harp will rhythm your pleasure. You'll feel light and love beyond any other, angels do not fail on passion!    
Tune your flute with Anemona, new XEN now available! Players can add Anemona to their Hangar, and this unit comes with special abilities that can be highly useful in combat.

[*] We have improved the artwork for the Delyss unit, and it's now available for a limited time in the Special Fragments section. We hope you enjoy the change!

[*] A static scene featuring our beloved XEN, Kana, has been animated. Enjoy it!
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1386950/Heavy_Metal_Babes/

notes.title: New Release Update 1.1.8
notes.content:
[b]New release update 1.1.8[/b]
[list]
[*] Welcome to the 5AT1SFLY3R Units! Upgrade your XEN Skill levels directly!
[*] Fix SpeedDown Debuff.
[*] Fixed the problem in some evolved skills, not correctly applying all the damage sometimes.
[*] Skins are now available for all the units of the same class.
[*] Players can now Select the Evolved or Normal skins for the XEN units.
[*] Aster unit 3rd skill Defense Down is applied after the impacts.
[*] New characters enter into the supercube roster: Mist, Luna, Hana, Heather. Also a low prob. of getting Lotus.
[*] New items in the premium flirt chest: Shoes & Books.
[*] New XEN Lab will require less energy (apply for new XEN Labs).
[*] Other bug fixes.
[/list]
